modal.policySubtitle: Things to know before renting your motorbike
policyItems: Bookings via WhatsApp. All bookings are handled directly by our team through WhatsApp so we can offer fast, personal assistance.
Rental payment. The price, payment method and any deposit will be shared and agreed before the booking is confirmed.
Flexible cancellations. Cancellation terms and any deposit refund conditions will be explained before any payment is made.
Valid driving licence required. You must hold a driving licence valid in Spain and suitable for the engine size and category of the selected motorbike.
Minimum age. The rider's minimum age and experience depend on the motorbike model and the terms of the insurance policy.

Refundable security deposit. A security deposit may be required; its amount will be shared before the rental is confirmed. Its return is subject to the contract terms and an inspection of the motorbike.
Mileage. The mileage included in the price and any excess mileage charges will be shared before the rental.
Drop-off and collection. The location, date and time for handover and return will be agreed in advance via WhatsApp.
Required documents. The customer must present valid identification and their original driving licence.
In-person contract. Before the motorbike is handed over, both parties will sign a contract detailing the rental terms, price and responsibilities.
Insurance. All motorbikes will have the required compulsory insurance. Cover, exclusions and any excess will be stated in the contract.
Motorbike condition. The vehicle will be inspected at handover and return to record any existing or new damage.
Responsible use. The rider must follow traffic laws and use the motorbike according to the agreed terms.
Personal assistance. If you have any questions about our motorbikes, availability, prices or requirements, we will be happy to help on WhatsApp.
